bio: Experience charm and atmosphere of Seckford Hall. The perfect place to share Afternoon Tea with friends and loved ones at this historic country estate.  Serving tier upon tier of delicious flavours, with a delightful selection of decadent cakes, sweet treats, sandwiches, homemade scones with indulgent clotted cream and preserves, complimented with a collection of artisan teas.  The 1530 Restaurant is full of heritage charm and mirrors the warm Tudor country house. 1530 Restaurant offers a stylish and comfortable setting to enjoy Afternoon Tea with the warmth of our acclaimed hospitality with service in the courtyard and terrace in warmer months.
